guarantees.claim: Each of in_ready_o, out_valid_o, state_we_o, sub_bytes_en_o, sub_bytes_out_ack_o, key_full_we_o, key_dec_we_o, key_expand_en_o, key_expand_out_ack_o, crypt_d, dec_key_gen_d is continuously assigned the value of its corresponding sp_* input after static cast to the sp2v_e enumerated type.
alert_o, prng_update_o, prng_reseed_req_o, and key_expand_clear_o are each the bitwise OR reduction of their corresponding multi-bit mr_* signal, so they assert high when any source bit is high.
prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, and data_out_clear_d are each the bitwise AND reduction of their corresponding multi-bit mr_* signal, so they assert high only when all source bits are high.

assumptions.claim: Each bit of the mr_alert multi-bit signal must correctly reflect an alert condition from its associated sub-module; a stuck-at-0 or incorrectly deasserted bit would mask that alert.
assumptions.risk: Critical faults may not be reported, allowing silent data corruption or security violations.

assumptions.claim: Each bit of mr_prng_update, mr_prng_reseed_req, and mr_key_expand_clear correctly represents the respective request/status from a sub-module; a stuck-at-0 bit prevents the combined signal from asserting.
assumptions.cond: when the sub-module requires PRNG update, reseed, or key expand clear
assumptions.risk: PRNG may starve, reseed may be missed, or key expansion clear may not occur, weakening cryptographic processes.

assumptions.claim: Each bit of mr_prng_reseed_d, mr_key_clear_d, and mr_data_out_clear_d must correctly indicate that the corresponding sub-module has completed its clear operation; if any bit remains low permanently, the AND-reduced clear signal will never assert.
assumptions.cond: when a clear operation is expected to complete
assumptions.risk: Clearing of sensitive PRNG state, key material, or output data may be stuck, leaving secrets exposed or failing to wipe.

uncertain_points.claim: The AND-based clear signals (prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, data_out_clear_d) rely on all sub-module clear-status bits being high; if any sub-module fails to assert its bit, the clear will never be acknowledged and the system may hang, potentially leaving sensitive data in registers.
uncertain_points.cond: a sub-module fault or deadlock that prevents its clear-done bit from going high
uncertain_points.risk: Deadlock and exposure of cryptographic keys, state, or output data.

uncertain_points.claim: The sp2v_e' cast may silently accept values not defined in the enumerated type; the synthesis/simulation behavior for out-of-range values is tool-dependent and could cause X propagation or mismatched behavior.
uncertain_points.cond: sp_* signals take an illegal value
uncertain_points.risk: Simulation-synthesis mismatch or undefined behavior in control logic.
